new-project-hint: What do you want to make?
prompt-first: Describe what you want to make
still-working: Still working on the last request.
made-private: The owner made this project private.
connecting: Connecting… try again in a moment.
usage-energy-note: Energy is measured only for work done in the pool, on the whole computer that did it.
board-empty: Nothing here yet. Double-click or double-tap to add text.
upscale-intro: Make a picture four times larger, on a computer in the pool or on Cloudflare. Only the model and the time are recorded, and the energy for work done in the pool, never the picture.
upscale-shrunk: It was made smaller first, to {w} × {h}.
upscale-done-paid: {w} × {h}, done in {s} s by {model} on Cloudflare, a paid service.
upscale-none: No computer in the pool can upscale right now.
estonia-about: Run on {date}. The judge can't count or check spelling, so look at the pictures too.
visuals-intro-estonia: Picture models each drew the same ten Estonian things. Most ran on Cloudflare’s computers, paid per picture. Older ones ran on our own Macs: DALL·E mini (2022) in a browser tab, Stable Diffusion models on the M1. For every picture, a judge model (Clef-flash) answered questions such as “Is the top stripe of the flag blue?”. A model’s score is the share of questions answered yes. Click a picture to see its answers.
visuals-intro-germany: Picture models each drew the same ten German things. Most ran on Cloudflare’s computers, paid per picture. Older ones ran on our own Macs: DALL·E mini (2022) in a browser tab, Stable Diffusion models on the M1. For every picture, a judge model (Clef-flash) answered questions such as “Is the top stripe of the flag black?”. A model’s score is the share of questions answered yes. Click a picture to see its answers.
visuals-not-run: This country hasn’t been run yet.
visuals-title-design: How well models know design classics
visuals-intro-design: Picture models each drew the same ten graphic design movements and methods, as posters. Most ran on Cloudflare’s computers, paid per picture. DALL·E mini (2022) ran in a browser tab on a Mac. For every picture, a judge model (Clef-flash) answered questions about what it can see, such as “Are there only horizontal and vertical black lines?”. A model’s score is the share of questions answered yes. Click a picture to see its answers.
upscale-for-fast: Makes the picture four times larger.
upscale-for-detailed: Four times larger, with more detail, slower.
upscale-for-klein: Redraws the picture larger and invents detail. It follows the instruction below, which you can change.
upscale-instruction-default: Recreate image 0 as a sharp, detailed, high-resolution version of itself. Keep the composition, colours, people, faces, clothing, patterns, text and every object exactly as they are; add only natural fine detail and texture.
upscale-no-instruction: This upscaler takes only the picture, no instruction. Pick a FLUX.2 klein model to write one.
upscale-for-klein4: Redraws the picture larger, like klein 9B but cheaper. It follows the instruction below.
draw-intro: Your words go to each model you tick exactly as you type them, with nothing added. They run on Cloudflare, paid per picture. Only the model, time and cost are recorded, never your words or the picture.
draw-for-flux-2-klein-4b: Black Forest Labs, 2026. The studio’s own picture model.
draw-for-flux-2-klein-9b: Black Forest Labs, 2026. Larger and sharper, often the fastest.
draw-for-flux-2-dev: Black Forest Labs. The best at text and detail in our tests, slower.
draw-for-phoenix-1.0: Leonardo. Its maker’s own model, run on Cloudflare.
draw-for-lucid-origin: Leonardo. Its maker’s own model, run on Cloudflare.
draw-for-sdxl: Stability AI, 2023. Leaves Cloudflare on 20 November 2026.
draw-for-sdxl-lightning: ByteDance, 2024. Fast, rough. Leaves Cloudflare on 20 November 2026.
draw-for-dreamshaper-8-lcm: Lykon, 2023. Made for 512 px, so larger sizes come out smeared. Leaves Cloudflare on 20 November 2026.
